title: garcinia dauphinensis
intro: Garcinia dauphinensis, commonly known as the Dauphin's garcinia, is a species of flowering plant in the family Clusiaceae. This plant has been found to have various health benefits, including aiding in weight loss, reducing inflammation, and lowering cholesterol levels. The therapeutic actions of Garcinia dauphinensis include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its potential in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
